 Background:

 On May 6, 2024, the City of Lynwood received a petition for a citizen’s initiative for a For-Profit
 Hospital Gross Receipts Tax Initiative. The petitions were circulated between February 15,
 2024, and April 25, 2024.

 On June 5, 2024, the Los Angeles County Registrar/County Clerk completed the signature
 verification submitted by the proponents for an initiative measure. The City Clerk was informed
 that a total of 5,316 signatures were gathered by proponents and 3,875 signatures were found
 to be sufficient meeting the required number to place an initiative on the ballot in accordance
 with California Elections Code section 9215.

 On July 16, 2024, the City Council adopted resolutions (1) Calling for and Giving Notice of the
 Election Relating the Imposition of a General Tax on the Gross Receipts of For-Profit
 Hospitals (2) Requesting the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles to
 Consolidate the November 5, 2024 Municipal Election with the Statewide General Election
 and (3) Setting Priorities for Filing Written Arguments, Rebuttals and Directing the City
 Attorney to Prepare an Impartial Analysis.

 Discussion and Analysis:

 On August 1, 2024, the proponents of the citizen’s initiative for a For-Profit Hospital Gross
 Receipts Tax Initiative filed a request with the City Clerk to withdraw the initiative ordinance
 from the ballot under California Elections Code section 9215.5 and California Elections Code
 section 9605.

 The proponents’ request to withdraw the initiative ordinance from the ballot initiative is
 consistent with the withdrawal procedures of the California Elections Code. Given the Notice
 of Withdrawal filed by proponents (1) the resolutions previously adopted by City Council must

  be rescinded; (2) a resolution withdrawing the initiative ordinance from the ballot must be
 approved by the City Council and (3) the resolution withdrawing the initiative ordinance
 previously submitted for placement on the ballot must the submitted to the Los Angeles
 County Registrar/County Clerk’s Office.

 Fiscal Impact:

 There is no fiscal impact associated with withdrawing the initiative ordinance from the ballot
 under California Elections Code section 9215.5 and California Elections Code section 9605.

 A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LYNWOOD,

 IMPOSITION OF A GENERAL TAX ON THE GROSS RECEIPTS OF FOR-PROFIT
 HOSPITALS, THE RESOLUTION REQUESTING THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
 OF THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES TO CONSOLIDATE THE NOVEMBER 5, 2024
 MUNICIPAL ELECTION WITH THE STATEWIDE GENERAL ELECTION AND THE

  WHEREAS, on May 6, 2024, the City of Lynwood received a petition for a citizen’s
initiative for a For-Profit Hospital Gross Receipts Tax Initiative; and

  WHEREAS, the petitions were circulated between February 15, 2024, and April
 25, 2024; and

  WHEREAS, on June 5, 2024, the Los Angeles County Registrar/County Clerk
completed the signature verification submitted on May 10, 2024, by proponents for an
initiative measure entitled: City of Lynwood For-Profit Hospital Gross Receipts Tax
Ordinance; and

  WHEREAS, on June 5, 2024, the Los Angeles County Registrar/County Clerk
informed the City Clerk that the signature verification for the petition submitted to their
office was completed; and

  WHEREAS, the City Clerk was informed that a total of 5,316 signatures were
gathered by proponents and 3,875 signatures were found to be sufficient meeting the
required number to place an initiative on the ballot in accordance with California Elections
Code section 9215; and

  WHEREAS, on July 16, 2024, the City Council adopted a resolution Calling for and
Giving Notice of a Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, for the
submission to voters the question of the imposition of a general tax on the gross receipts
of for-profit hospitals operating within the City of Lynwood; and

  WHEREAS, on July 16, 2024, the City Council adopted a resolution requesting the
Board of Supervisors to Consolidate the Municipal Election to be held on November 5,
2024, with the Statewide General Election; and

  7
   WHEREAS, on July 16, 2024, the City Council adopted a resolution setting
priorities for filing written arguments and rebuttals regarding a measure for the November
5, 2024, Municipal Election and directing the City Attorney to prepare an impartial
analysis; and

  WHEREAS, on August 1, 2024, the proponents of the citizen’s initiative for a For-
Profit Hospital Gross Receipts Tax Initiative filed a request with the City Clerk to withdraw
the initiative ordinance from the ballot under California Elections Code section 9215.5 and
California Elections Code section 9605; and

  WHEREAS, the proponents’ request to withdraw the initiative ordinance from the
ballot initiative is consistent with the withdrawal procedures of the California Elections
Code; and

  WHEREAS, the City Council desires to rescind all resolutions approved on July
16, 2024.

  NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS:

  Section 1.  The City Council of the City of Lynwood hereby finds and declares
that the foregoing recitals are true and correct, and incorporates them herein as findings
and as a substantive part of this Resolution.

  Section 2.  The City Council hereby approves the proponents’ request to
withdraw the initiative ordinance described above from the November 5, 2024, ballot.

  Section 3.  The City Council hereby rescinds all resolutions approved on July
16, 2024.

  Section 4.  The Mayor is authorized to execute this Resolution for and on behalf
of the City of Lynwood.

  Section 5.  The City Clerk is authorized and directed to take all actions
necessary to withdraw the initiative ordinance from the November 5, 2024, ballot.

I hereby certify that the foregoing Resolution was adopted by the Council of the City of
Lynwood at its meeting held on August 7, 2024.
